notes.title: 20250913 Update note
notes.notes: [p]1. You no longer have to wait to refresh your pet at the Pet Shop in the second round.[/p][p]2. The Black Shop now sells Pet Enhancement Pills.[/p][p]3. A new "Rich" gold enchantment has been added, increasing gold earned in battle by 100%.[/p][p]4. Item names now display a ★ tier, with higher ★ tiers indicating stronger equipment.[/p][p]5. The orange "War God" enchantment now increases all abilities by +500.[/p][p]6. The enchantment crafting interface in the Enchanting Shop now displays enchantment effects.[/p][p]7. The Shield skill - Taunt now has a new Guardian effect, protecting pets with less than 1/4 HP from damage.[/p]

notes.title: 20250908 Update note
notes.notes: [p]Regarding enchantment acquisition, the system has been changed from a fixed random table to real-time randomization.[/p][p]When I first designed this part, I struggled with the decision for quite a while. My main intention was to encourage players to experiment with different combinations of enchantments, rather than simply following guides to build the exact setup they wanted.[/p][p]Since I don’t want players to spend too much time repeating the same actions, I added many convenient features such as Mass Raid, Teleport, Fast Walk, and so on. For the same reason, I initially decided to keep enchantments on a fixed random table, to avoid players having to save-load repeatedly.[/p][p]However, as more and more players voiced their dislike for this design, I’ve decided to revert to real-time randomization. Now, players are free to use repeated save-loading to obtain the enchantments they want.[/p]

notes.title: 20250906 Update note
notes.notes: [p]1. Added a shortcut key "F6" to quickly turn the game sound on and off.[/p][p]2. At the maximum level of the Wilderness Survival skill, the "Real All-out raid" can be learned.[/p][p]3. If you do not adopt a pet you obtain that is not sold at a pet shop, you can sell it directly to the shop for cash.[/p][p]4. Added a teleport point to the "Adventurer's Guild" for teleportation.[/p][p]5. When the game is in the background, even if a small part is visible, it will continue to play without pausing.[/p][p]6. Adjusted the distance between each character's ability stats and their ability titles in the main menu to reduce readability.[/p]

notes.title: 20250817 Update note
notes.notes:
1. Added a Serious Mode challenge for the Angel's Lament four-player team at the top of the Infinite Labyrinth.
2. As mentioned above, successful challenges will grant new skills for the corresponding classes.
3. Adjusted the effects of some orange enchantments. Enchantments that enhance a single ability now grant additional percentage-based abilities.
4. Raised the ability value cap to 99,999.
5. Added the Abyss Gate challenge. After completing the Infinite Labyrinth challenge (passing it in its original mode, not the Serious Mode mentioned in point 1), you can challenge it in the Arena at night.

notes.title: 20250802 Update note
notes.notes: [p]1. Fixed an issue where using Roar in the Arena would cause additional enemies to appear.[/p][p]2. Fixed an issue where Clear's order would be forced to the first position after the Arena ended.[/p][p]3. After winning a challenge, if you are the defending champion, you will receive an additional 5 Creator Onions.[/p][p]4. Reduced the chance of being challenged. Each overnight stay has a 10% chance of being challenged.[/p][p]5. Improved the Skeleton Warrior's skill damage calculation formula to better match its role as a Glass Cannon.[/p]

notes.title: 20250705 update note
notes.notes: [p]1. The enchantment shop has added an enchantment synthesis function, which can synthesize 5 enchanted equipment of the same quality into a higher-level enchanted stone brick.[/p][p]2. The upper limit of the production series skill level is raised to level 100, and a new "God-level Enchantment" skill is added, which can be used to enchant equipment with orange colors.[/p]

notes.title: 20250329 Update note
notes.notes:
1. Improve the basic ability values ​​of the hero to make it more suitable for a hero.
2.Fixed bugs.

notes.title: 20250212 Update note
notes.notes:
1. Modify the birdman's wish skill - Queen's Wings, and add the effect "will be automatically attached once the battle starts".
2. Modify the Little Devil's burst skill - Dark Prison's Wrath, and change it to "the more current MP, the more attacks you can get."
3. Modify the little devil's wish skill - Devil's Revenge, and change the effect to "Once someone attacks him, he will be able to act immediately."
4. Modify the Skeleton Knight's wish skill - Hollow Knight. The effect is changed to "As long as the owner is alive, 50 MP will be consumed to immediately revive and restore 1 HP, and can act immediately."
5.Fixed bugs.

notes.title: 20250210 Update note
notes.notes:
1. Modify the effect of Slime God's slime explosion from the original increase speed of 50% to a 50% increase in all abilities.
2. Physical shield and magic shield are now cast on all allies.
3. Slime gains a new passive skill called Death Contribution at level 75. When a Slime dies, it will attach its elastic mucus to its companions, reducing the damage taken by them by 50%.
4. The Vampire Bat's Wish Skill - Blood Swiftness, no longer requires more than three enemies, and changes it to "Each attack of Multiple Swiftness will cause double damage."
5. The vampire bat's burst skill - Rapid Burst, has its effect modified to "It can take two actions per round for a period of time, and can take the next action immediately."
6. The vampire bat's skill - Night Shadow Swift Attack has an effect added: "After using it, the player will be in Night Shadow state, and the evasion rate will be temporarily increased by 50%."
7. The Nine-Tailed Fox's burst skill can be affected by double casting.
8. Increase the recovery amount of healing series and all healing series magic.
9.Fixed bugs.

notes.title: 20250207 Update note
notes.notes:
1. Increase the chance of cannibal-type enemies dropping rotten flesh.
2. The archer's archery skill is changed to string shooting which does not consume arrows.
3. On the map screen, if your profession is an archer, the number of arrows you currently hold will be displayed in the upper left corner of the status panel.
4. Achievement - Professional Mastery increases the judgment of the Brave Profession. If you enter the second round of the Brave Profession without obtaining this achievement, you can also obtain this achievement if all the skill series of the six major professions are at level 99.
5. Extend the number of steps of using the lighting tube.
6. Optimize the Quicksand Slope mini-game to reduce lag.
7. Added the function of turning off the running energy estimation prompt.
8.Fixed bugs.

notes.title: 20250204 Update note
notes.notes:
1. Improve the effectiveness of combat and make combat smoother.
2. Bug fixes

notes.title: 20250202 Update note
notes.notes:
1. Adjust the second round mechanism, add inheritable equipment and all props, as well as the ability parameters that the characters have added.
2. A new Hell difficulty level is added in the second round.
3. Add shortcut keys for avoiding enemies.
4. Adjusted Izayoi's attack method to avoid excessive reduction in effectiveness.
5.Fixed bugs.

notes.title: 20250128 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Reduce the selling price of arrows.
2. Increase the damage coefficient of archery skills.
3. Reduce the number of arrows required for some archery skills.
4.Changed the display mode of mining and finding herbs to pop-up text display.
5. Increase the chance of finding minerals and herbs.
6. The treasure chest monsters that you randomly encounter will be encountered only when you are at level 20 or above.
7. The damage effects of Berserk Arrow and Charm Arrow have been changed, and the targets have been changed to all enemies, but the probability of additional status has been reduced.
8. The blue and gold enchantments in the casino are now subject to a redemption quantity limit.
9. Add shortcut keys for skills such as Thief's Nose, Setting Up a Tent, and Stealth.
10. Modify the werewolf's Night Moon Mad Wolf skill, the original absolute critical hit is changed to +100% critical hit rate.
11. Modify the final BOSS to further enhance its abilities when in difficult difficulty.
12. Added an achievement, which can be obtained by defeating the final boss on hard difficulty.
13. Bug fixes.

notes.title: 20250126 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Reduce the SXP required to upgrade skill levels
2. Strengthen the dragon's dragon teeth and dragon jaws, and increase the number of attacks of the dragon extinguishing skill.
3. Strengthen the Goblin's black technology skills, which can reduce the waiting rounds of trap skills by 1.
4. Strengthen the Goblin's gravity trap effect and increase the damage limit to 99999.
5. Expand the effect of the Survival Expert enchantment to increase the SXP gained when equipping Clear.
6. Expanded enchantment - Tisiphone's, so that disabled skills will not be selected as counterattack skills.
7. Modify the effect of the Tyrant enchantment and change it to critical damage +100% (only effective once).
8.Fixed bugs.

notes.title: 20250122 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Fire attribute attack magic is changed to single target multiple attacks.
2. The attack range of ice, wind, and dark attack magic is increased.
3. Added a skill shutdown function. After opening the skill menu, you can press shift to shut down the skill. The shut-down skill will not be visible in battle, and the skill will not be used in automatic combat.
4. The Rogue Skills series adds a skill remake function, which can restore the skill level to level 1 for re-learning.
5. Adjusted the arrangement of skill selection windows during combat.
6. Adjust pet strengthening pills so that they can be used directly and quickly in succession.
7. Fix errors.

notes.title: 20250120-Update Announcement
notes.notes:
1. The sale of prizes redeemed in the casino is prohibited.
2. The enchantment effects of Sapindus mukorossi and Sakirin will only take effect when facing strong enough enemies.
3. The buff effect of Bo Hao is changed to +fixed value.
4. Added the function of changing the difficulty of Clear's bed.
5. The enemy's critical hit cancels the damage increase effect.
6.Fix bugs.
